 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u000/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d4eb9665.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Tile four quarter-turn rotations of the input into a 2x2 grid."""
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    return [grid[i] + clockwise[i] for i in range(n)] + [
        counterclockwise[i] + half_turn[i] for i in range(n)
    ]
"
